answer: Give every identity a slowly refilling reservoir of capability tokens: each attestation, grade, or vote spends one, and tokens are earned only by doing verified useful work for others, never bought or transferred. A pearl of genuine service accrues over months; a sybil farm minting a thousand sparrow identities gets a thousand shallow trickles, each too thin to move any outcome, while a real participant's deep reservoir speaks with weight. Splitting effort dilutes it, and the relic of past service is the only way to refill, so forgery costs exactly what honesty costs.
